hero.title: MBS in Mauritius for Indian Students
paras: **MBS in Mauritius** is a postgraduate business qualification generally associated with advanced study in management, business strategy, finance, marketing, and organisational leadership. Students considering an MBS in Mauritius should carefully check the exact degree title offered by each institution, as an MBS is not the same qualification as an MBA or an MSc in Management. Students researching a **Master of Business Studies in Mauritius** should also compare the available postgraduate business qualifications before selecting a programme.

highlights.title: Bilingual & English Degrees
highlights.desc: Study in English with recognized qualifications from national institutions and global UK/Australian branch campuses.

highlights.title: Affordable Tuition & Living
highlights.desc: High quality tertiary education with tuition fees and living costs substantially lower than Western Europe.

highlights.title: Safe & Multicultural Island
highlights.desc: Consistently ranked as the safest and most politically stable nation in Africa with close cultural ties to India.

highlights.title: Simplified Visa Process
highlights.desc: Streamlined student visa procedures arranged directly through recognized higher education institutions.

overview: For the 2026–2027 academic year, the University of Mauritius lists programmes such as the MBA, MSc International Business Management, and MSc Finance, rather than a degree specifically titled Master of Business Studies in its published postgraduate programme list. Students seeking a similar business-focused postgraduate qualification can explore these alternatives. These **business master's programmes in Mauritius** provide different academic and professional pathways for students interested in management and business studies.

items.q: Can Indian students apply for MBS in Mauritius?
items.a: Yes, Indian students meeting the academic criteria and English proficiency requirements can apply to recognized Mauritian institutions.

items.q: What is the medium of instruction for MBS in Mauritius?
items.a: Programmes at major Mauritian universities are delivered in English, with bilingual options available at select institutions.

items.q: What are the typical tuition fees for MBS in Mauritius?
items.a: Tuition fees generally range between MUR 150,000 and MUR 350,000 per year, offering cost-effective international degree options.

items.q: Is a student visa required for Indian students?
items.a: Yes, international students require an entry permit and student visa issued by the Passport and Immigration Office of Mauritius upon receiving admission.
